function t1.GetLevel(levels,id) return tonumber(levels[id]) or 0 end
function t1.GetCost(id,level)
    local n=t1.Nodes[id]
    if n and level<n.MaxLevel then return n.Costs[level+1] or n.Costs[#n.Costs] end
end
function t1.IsUnlocked(levels,id)
    for _,parent in ipairs(t1.Nodes[id].Requires or {}) do
        if not t1.Nodes[parent] or t1.GetLevel(levels,parent)<t1.Nodes[parent].MaxLevel then return false end
    end
    return true
end
function t1.Total(levels,effect)
    local total=0
    for id,n in pairs(t1.Nodes) do if n.Effect==effect then total=total+t1.GetLevel(levels,id)*n.PerLevel end end
    return total
end
return t1
end)()

local managedTasks = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local alive = true

local themes = {
    Ocean = Color3.fromRGB(67, 137, 235), Amethyst = Color3.fromRGB(156, 111, 235),
    Forest = Color3.fromRGB(46, 165, 133), Rose = Color3.fromRGB(211, 103, 151)
}
local themeName, accent = "Ocean", themes.Ocean
local themedObjects = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local cinemaMode = true
local function themeColor(color)
    local hue = accent:ToHSV()
    local _, saturation, brightness = color:ToHSV()
    return Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.min(saturation, brightness > 0.6 and 0.18 or 0.55), brightness)
end
local function surfaceColor(color)
    if not cinemaMode then return themeColor(color) end
    local _, _, brightness = color:ToHSV()
    local gray = math.clamp(brightness * 0.22, 0.015, 0.085)
    return Color3.new(gray, gray, gray)
end
local function spawnManaged(callback, ...)
    if not alive then return nil end
    local args = table.pack(...)
    local thread = task.spawn(function()
        if alive then callback(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)) end
    end)
    managedTasks[thread] = true
    return thread
end
local function bind(signal, callback)
    local c = signal:Connect(callback)
    table.insert(connections, c)
    return c
end
local function make(class, parent, props)
    local obj = Instance.new(class)
    local colors = {}
    for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
        if typeof(value) == "Color3" and (key == "BackgroundColor3" or key == "TextColor3" or key == "PlaceholderColor3" or key == "ScrollBarImageColor3" or key == "Color") then
            colors[key] = value
            obj[key] = key == "BackgroundColor3" and surfaceColor(value) or themeColor(value)
        else obj[key] = value end
    end
    themedObjects[obj] = colors
    if class == "Frame" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox" then
        obj:SetAttribute("BaseSurfaceTransparency", props and props.BackgroundTransparency or 0)
    end
    if cinemaMode and props and props.BackgroundTransparency == nil and (class == "Frame" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox") then
        local root = parent and parent:IsA("ScreenGui")
        obj.BackgroundTransparency = root and 0 or ((props.ZIndex or 1) >= 9 and 0.04 or (class == "Frame" and 0.62 or 0.28))
    end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end
local function round(obj, radius)
    make("UICorner", obj, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 12)})
end
local function label(parent, text, pos, size, fontSize, color)
    return make("TextLabel", parent, {Text = text, Position = pos, Size = size,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = fontSize or 13,
        TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(226, 234, 249), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd})
end
local gui
local unloading = false
local function unload(destroyUI)
    if unloading then return end
    unloading = true
    alive, captureKey = false, false
    for key in pairs(enabled) do enabled[key] = false end
    -- Disable immediately to release mouse input, even if a later cleanup fails.
    if gui then pcall(function() gui.Enabled = false end) end
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(connections)
    local current = coroutine.running()
    for thread in pairs(managedTasks) do
        if thread ~= current and coroutine.status(thread) ~= "dead" then pcall(task.cancel, thread) end
    end
    table.clear(managedTasks)
    if destroyUI and gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
end

local function draggable(handle, target)
    local start, origin, inputType, moved
    bind(handle.InputBegan, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            start, origin, inputType, moved = input.Position, target.Position, input.UserInputType, false
        end
    end)
    bind(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
        if start and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = input.Position - start
            if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
            if moved then
                local divisor = 1
                target.Position = UDim2.new(origin.X.Scale, origin.X.Offset + d.X / divisor, origin.Y.Scale, origin.Y.Offset + d.Y / divisor)
            end
        end
    end)
    bind(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
        if start and input.UserInputType == inputType then
            start = nil
            if target == reopen and not moved then show(true) end
        end
    end)
end

local function syncOverlayPages()
    local open = false
    for _, child in ipairs(overlayHost:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then open = true; break end
    end
    for name, page in pairs(pages) do page.Visible = name == activePage and not open end
    pageTitle.Visible, pageSubtitle.Visible = not open, not open
    pointsLabel.Visible, restockLabel.Visible = not open, not open
    if footer then footer.Visible = not open end
end
local function selectPage(name)
    activePage = name
    for _, child in ipairs(overlayHost:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child.Visible = false end end
    for _, spec in ipairs(pageSpecs) do
        pages[spec[1]].Visible = spec[1] == name
        navigation[spec[1]].BackgroundColor3 = cinemaMode and (spec[1] == name and Color3.fromRGB(37, 37, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(13, 13, 15)) or (spec[1] == name and accent:Lerp(themeColor(Color3.fromRGB(17, 24, 39)), 0.7) or themeColor(Color3.fromRGB(17, 24, 39)))
        navigation[spec[1]].TextColor3 = spec[1] == name and Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(166, 184, 213)
        if spec[1] == name then pageTitle.Text, pageSubtitle.Text = name, spec[2] end
    end
end

        status[key].Text = enabled[key] and "Checking..." or "Off"
    end)
end

    themeName, accent = name, themes[name]
    for obj, colors in pairs(themedObjects) do
        if obj.Parent and not obj:GetAttribute("KeepPalette") then
            for property, original in pairs(colors) do obj[property] = property == "BackgroundColor3" and surfaceColor(original) or themeColor(original) end
        end

    panelStroke.Color = cinemaMode and Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 59) or accent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(12, 17, 29), 0.65)
    for _, page in pairs(pages) do page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent end
    for key, toggle in pairs(toggleViews) do toggle.BackgroundColor3 = enabled[key] and (cinemaMode and Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 67) or accent) or surfaceColor(Color3.fromRGB(44, 54, 74)) end
    for n, b in pairs(themeButtons) do b.Text = (n == name and "✓ " or "") .. n end
    selectPage(activePage)
    if refreshExtrasTheme then refreshExtrasTheme() end
end

local function path(root, ...)
    for _, key in ipairs({...}) do
        root = root and root:FindFirstChild(key)
        if not root then return nil end
    end
    return root
end
local Skills
local retryIndex, retrySkill = {}, {}
local pendingSkill
local function dataFolder()
    return path(RS, "Players_Data", player.Name)
end
local function tickIndex(data)
    local index = path(data, "Index")
    local remote = path(RS, "Remotes", "Index", "Seen")
    if not index or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        status.index.Text = "Waiting for Index data / Seen remote"
        return
    end
    local viewed = index:FindFirstChild("Viewed")
    local lastSeen = index:FindFirstChild("LastSeen")
    local categories = index:GetChildren()
    local sent = 0
    table.sort(categories, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
    for _, category in ipairs(categories) do
        if category:IsA("Folder") and category.Name ~= "Viewed" then
            for _, item in ipairs(category:GetChildren()) do
                local known = path(viewed, category.Name, item.Name)
                local eligible = item:IsA("NumberValue") and not known
                if eligible and lastSeen and lastSeen:IsA("NumberValue") then eligible = item.Value > lastSeen.Value end
                if eligible then
                    local key = category.Name .. ":" .. item.Name
                    if os.clock() >= (retryIndex[key] or 0) then
                        if not alive or not enabled.index then return end
                        retryIndex[key] = os.clock() + 3
                        remote:FireServer(category.Name, item.Name)
                        sent = sent + 1
                        status.index.Text = "Collecting: " .. category.Name .. " / " .. item.Name
                        if sent >= 2 then return end -- Bounded queue: up to two requests per 0.12 s.
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if sent == 0 then status.index.Text = "Waiting for new discoveries / confirmation" end
end
local function tickSkills(data)
    if not Skills then Skills = configSnapshot.Skills end
    local folder = path(data, "Skills", "Levels") or path(data, "Skills")
    local points = path(data, "Data", "Currency", Skills.CURRENCY)
    local remote = path(RS, "Remotes", "Skills", "Upgrade")
    if not folder or not points or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        status.skills.Text = "Waiting for skill data / Upgrade remote"
        return
    end
    local levels = {}
    for _, value in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if value:IsA("ValueBase") then levels[value.Name] = tonumber(value.Value) or 0 end
    end
    if pendingSkill then
        if Skills.GetLevel(levels, pendingSkill.id) > pendingSkill.level then
            status.skills.Text = "Upgraded: " .. (Skills.Nodes[pendingSkill.id].Name or pendingSkill.id)
            pendingSkill = nil
        elseif os.clock() < pendingSkill.deadline then
            status.skills.Text = "Waiting for upgrade confirmation"
            return
        else
            retrySkill[pendingSkill.id] = os.clock() + 2
            pendingSkill = nil
        end
    end
    local candidates = {}
    local balance = tonumber(points.Value) or 0
    for id, node in pairs(Skills.Nodes) do
        local level = Skills.GetLevel(levels, id)
        local cost = Skills.GetCost(id, level)
        if cost and cost <= balance and Skills.IsUnlocked(levels, id) and os.clock() >= (retrySkill[id] or 0) then
            table.insert(candidates, {id = id, node = node, cost = cost, level = level})
        end
    end
    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
        if a.cost ~= b.cost then return a.cost < b.cost end
        if a.node.Row ~= b.node.Row then return a.node.Row < b.node.Row end
        return a.id < b.id
    end)
    local nextSkill = candidates[1]
    if not nextSkill then status.skills.Text = "Waiting for Paw Points / available upgrades"; return end
    if not alive or not enabled.skills then return end
    pendingSkill = {id = nextSkill.id, level = nextSkill.level, deadline = os.clock() + 2.5}
    remote:FireServer(nextSkill.id)
    status.skills.Text = "Requested: " .. nextSkill.node.Name .. " (" .. nextSkill.cost .. " points)"
end
local errorReports = {}
local function reportFailure(key, err)
    local text = tostring(err)
    local old = errorReports[key]
    if not old or old.text ~= text or os.clock() >= old.at then
        warn("[NoLimit " .. key .. "] " .. text)
        errorReports[key] = {text=text, at=os.clock()+30}
    end
end
local function guarded(key, callback, data)
    if not enabled[key] then return end
    local ok, err = pcall(callback, data)
    if not ok and alive then
        status[key].Text = "Error — see F9 console"
        reportFailure(key, err)
    end
end

-- Observe the game's local interaction events without executing its modules.
-- Never acquire an animal, move the character or choose a target automatically.
local autoPet = {marker=nil, cooldown=15, nextAt=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}), wired=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})}
function autoPet.stop()
    autoPet.marker=nil
end
function autoPet.started(entry)
    autoPet.stop()
    if type(entry)=="table" and typeof(entry.Marker)=="Instance" then
        autoPet.marker=entry.Marker
    end
end
function autoPet.stopped(entry)
    if type(entry)~="table" or entry.Marker==autoPet.marker then autoPet.stop() end
end
function autoPet.loved(entry)
    if type(entry)=="table" and typeof(entry.Marker)=="Instance" then
        autoPet.nextAt[entry.Marker]=os.clock()+autoPet.cooldown
    end
end
function autoPet.wire()
    local group=path(RS,"Remotes","AnimalInteraction")
    if not group then return end
    for name,callback in pairs({Started=autoPet.started,Stopped=autoPet.stopped,Loved=autoPet.loved}) do
        local event=group:FindFirstChild(name)
        if event and event:IsA("BindableEvent") and not autoPet.wired[event] then
            bind(event.Event,callback)
            autoPet.wired[event]=true
        end
    end
    local windows=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Windows")
    local exit=windows and windows:FindFirstChild("ExitInteract",true)
    if exit and exit:IsA("GuiButton") and not autoPet.wired[exit] then
        bind(exit.Activated,autoPet.stop)
        autoPet.wired[exit]=true
    end
end
bind(player.CharacterRemoving,autoPet.stop)
bind(UIS.InputBegan,function(input)
    if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() and (input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Q or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB) then
        autoPet.stop()
    end
end)
local function tickAutoPet()
    local marker=autoPet.marker
    local windows=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Windows")
    local exit=windows and windows:FindFirstChild("ExitInteract",true)
    local character=player.Character
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not marker or not marker.Parent or not exit or not exit.Visible or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0
        or player:GetAttribute("InGameplay")==true or player:GetAttribute("InRun")==true then
        autoPet.stop()
        status.autopet.Text="Waiting: select an animal with F"
        return
    end
    if marker:GetAttribute("InteractingWith")~=player.UserId then
        status.autopet.Text="Waiting for interaction confirmation"
        return
    end
    local owner=marker:GetAttribute("OwnerId")
    local remote=path(RS,"Remotes","AnimalInteraction","PetAnimal")
    if type(owner)~="number" or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        status.autopet.Text="Waiting for animal data / PetAnimal"
        return
    end
    local remaining=(autoPet.nextAt[marker] or 0)-os.clock()
    if remaining>0 then
        status.autopet.Text="Petting selected animal · next in "..math.ceil(remaining).."s"
        return
    end
    if not alive or not enabled.autopet then return end
    autoPet.nextAt[marker]=os.clock()+autoPet.cooldown
    remote:FireServer(marker.Name,owner)
    status.autopet.Text="Petted selected animal · 15s Bond cooldown"
end
spawnManaged(function()
    while alive do
        autoPet.wire()
        guarded("autopet",tickAutoPet)
        task.wait(0.25)
    end
end)

-- Rewards use their own worker: a slow server reply cannot block Index or Skills.
local RewardsConfig, QuestsConfig
local rewardRetry = {}
local function rewardsActive()
    return alive and enabled.rewards
end
local function rewardStatus(text)
    if rewardsActive() then status.rewards.Text = text end
end
local function rewardRemote(group, name)
    local remote = path(RS, "Remotes", group, name)
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        error("Missing RemoteFunction: " .. group .. "." .. name)
    end
    return remote
end
local function claimReward(group, name, key, ...)
    if not rewardsActive() or os.clock() < (rewardRetry[key] or 0) then return end
    rewardRetry[key] = os.clock() + 3
    local remote = rewardRemote(group, name)
    local ok, success, message = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, ...)
    task.wait(0.2) -- Space claims so an early reward cannot consume the whole burst.
    if not rewardsActive() then return end
    if not ok then
        rewardStatus("Retrying: " .. key)
        reportFailure("Rewards", success)
    elseif success == true then
        rewardStatus("Collected: " .. key)
    else
        rewardStatus("Not collected; will check again")
        if type(message) == "string" then warn("[NoLimit Rewards] " .. message) end
    end
end
local function tickDailyAndPlaytime()
    if not RewardsConfig then RewardsConfig = configSnapshot.RewardsConfig end
    if not rewardsActive() then return end
    local state = rewardRemote("Rewards", "GetState"):InvokeServer()
    if not rewardsActive() then return end
    if type(state) ~= "table" then error("Invalid Rewards.GetState response") end
    local daily = state.Daily
    if type(daily) == "table" and daily.Ready == true then
        claimReward("Rewards", "ClaimDaily", "Daily day " .. tostring(daily.Next))
    end
    if not rewardsActive() then return end
    local playtime = state.Playtime
    if type(playtime) ~= "table" or type(playtime.Claimed) ~= "table" then
        error("Missing playtime state")
    end
    local seconds = player:GetAttribute("PlaytimeToday")
    if type(seconds) ~= "number" then seconds = tonumber(playtime.Seconds) or 0 end
    for i, entry in ipairs(RewardsConfig.Playtime) do
        if not rewardsActive() then return end
        if playtime.Claimed[tostring(i)] ~= true and playtime.Claimed[i] ~= true and seconds >= entry.Minutes * 60 then
            claimReward("Rewards", "ClaimPlaytime", "Playtime " .. tostring(i), i)
        end
    end
end
local function tickQuestRewards()
    if not QuestsConfig then QuestsConfig = configSnapshot.QuestsConfig end
    if not (alive and enabled.quests) then return end
    local state = rewardRemote("Quests", "GetState"):InvokeServer()
    if not (alive and enabled.quests) then return end
    if type(state) ~= "table" then error("Invalid Quests.GetState response") end
    for _, category in ipairs({"Daily", "Weekly"}) do
        local section = state[category]
        local pool = QuestsConfig.Pools[category]
        if type(section) == "table" and type(section.List) == "table" and type(pool) == "table" then
            for i, quest in ipairs(section.List) do
                if not (alive and enabled.quests) then return end
                local definition = pool[quest.Id]
                if definition and not quest.Claimed and (tonumber(quest.Progress) or 0) >= definition.Target then
                    local key = tostring(section.ResetAt) .. ":" .. category .. " quest " .. tostring(i) .. ":" .. tostring(quest.Id)
                    if os.clock() >= (rewardRetry[key] or 0) then
                        rewardRetry[key] = os.clock() + 3
                        local remote = rewardRemote("Quests", "Claim")
                        local ok, success = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, category, i)
                        if not ok then reportFailure("Quests", success) end
                        if alive and enabled.quests then status.quests.Text = ok and success == true and "Collected " .. category .. " quest" or "Waiting for quest confirmation" end
                        task.wait(0.2)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
spawnManaged(function()
    local nextCheck = 0
    while alive do
        if rewardsActive() and os.clock() >= nextCheck then
            nextCheck = os.clock() + 3
            rewardStatus("Watching for available rewards")
            -- Keep quests working even if the daily/playtime service returns an error.
            for _, callback in ipairs({tickDailyAndPlaytime}) do
                if not rewardsActive() then break end
                local ok, err = pcall(callback)
                if not ok then
                    rewardStatus("Rewards check failed — see F9 console")
                    reportFailure("Rewards", err)
                end
            end
        elseif not enabled.rewards then
            nextCheck = 0
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)
spawnManaged(function()
    while alive do
        fit()
        local data = dataFolder()
        local points = path(data, "Data", "Currency", "PawPoints")
        pointsLabel.Text = points and ("Paw Points: " .. tostring(points.Value)) or "Paw Points: waiting for data"
        guarded("index", tickIndex, data)
        guarded("skills", tickSkills, data)
        task.wait(0.12)
    end
end)

-- Shop automation. Read the live balanced config; never use the paid restock.
local shopSelected = {animals = {}, foods = {}, decorations = {}}
local shopConfig, shopData, shopInfo, shopSkills
local shopCategory = {animals = "Animal", foods = "Food", decorations = "Decoration"}
local shopWindows = {animals="AnimalsShopFrame",foods="FoodsShopFrame",decorations="DecorationsShopFrame"}
local function textOf(object)
    if not object then return "" end
    local child = object:FindFirstChild("Label")
    if child and (child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton")) then return child.Text end
    if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") then return object.Text end
    for _,v in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("TextLabel") and v.Text ~= "" then return v.Text end end
    return ""
end
local function parseShopMoney(text)
    text = text:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub(",", ""):gsub("%s", ""):upper()
    if not text:find("$",1,true) then return nil end
    local number,suffix=text:match("(%d+%.?%d*)([KMBT]?)")
    local factor=({K=1e3,M=1e6,B=1e9,T=1e12})[suffix] or 1
    return number and tonumber(number)*factor or nil
end
local function loadShops()
    if not shopConfig then
        shopConfig={Currency="Cash",Animal={},Food={},Decoration={}}
        shopInfo={animals={},foods={},decorations={}}
    end
    local windows=playerGui:FindFirstChild("Windows")
    for key,windowName in pairs(shopWindows) do
        local window=windows and windows:FindFirstChild(windowName,true)
        if window then
            for _,object in ipairs(window:GetDescendants()) do
                if object.Name=="BuyButton" and object:IsA("GuiButton") then
                    local row=object.Parent
                    local nameLabel=row:FindFirstChild(key=="animals" and "AnimalNameLabel" or (key=="foods" and "FoodNameLabel" or "DecorationNameLabel")) or row:FindFirstChild("NameLabel")
                    if nameLabel and row.Visible then
                        local id=row.Name
                        local old=shopConfig[shopCategory[key]][id]
                        shopConfig[shopCategory[key]][id]={Price=parseShopMoney(textOf(object)) or (old and old.Price) or math.huge,Row=row,Button=object}
                        shopInfo[key][id]={DisplayName=textOf(nameLabel)}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
local function shopPrice(entry)
    if not entry.Button.Parent then return math.huge end
    return parseShopMoney(textOf(entry.Button)) or entry.Price or math.huge
end
local function shopStock(key,id)
    local value=path(dataFolder(),"OnStocks",shopCategory[key],id,"Amount")
    if value and value:IsA("ValueBase") then return tonumber(value.Value) or 0 end
    local entry=shopConfig and shopConfig[shopCategory[key]][id]
    local row=entry and entry.Row
    if row then
        for _,label in ipairs(row:GetDescendants()) do
            if label:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local n=label.Text:lower():match("x(%d+)%s*stock")
                if n then return tonumber(n) end
            end
        end
    end
    return 0
end
local function shopUnlocked(key,id,entry)
    local buttonText=textOf(entry.Button):lower()
    return not buttonText:find("lock",1,true) and not buttonText:find("tame",1,true)
end

local function cashBalance()
    local value = path(dataFolder(), "Data", "Currency", shopConfig.Currency)
    return value and tonumber(value.Value)
end

local pickerTitle = label(picker, "Select items", UDim2.fromOffset(24, 22), UDim2.fromOffset(320, 28), 20)

local pickerKey, pickerRows = nil, {}

local function refreshPicker()
    loadShops()
    for _, key in ipairs({"animals", "foods", "decorations"}) do
        local count = 0
        for _ in pairs(shopSelected[key]) do count = count + 1 end
        selectionButtons[key].Text = (key == "animals" and "Animals to buy" or (key == "foods" and "Food to buy" or "Decorations to buy")) .. "  ·  " .. count .. " selected"
    end
    if not pickerKey then return end
    local y = 0
    for _, rowInfo in ipairs(pickerRows) do
        local id, button = rowInfo.id, rowInfo.button
        local entry = shopConfig[shopCategory[pickerKey]][id]
        local name = (shopInfo[pickerKey][id] or {}).DisplayName or id
        local visible = string.find(string.lower(name .. " " .. id), string.lower(search.Text), 1, true) ~= nil
        button.Visible = visible
        if visible then
            button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
            y = y + 80
            local selected = shopSelected[pickerKey][id]
            rowInfo.text.Text = name
            local price = shopPrice(entry)
            rowInfo.detail.Text = (price < math.huge and ("$" .. tostring(price)) or "Price pending") .. "    /    Stock: " .. shopStock(pickerKey, id)
                .. (shopUnlocked(pickerKey, id, entry) and "" or "    /    Locked")
            rowInfo.check.Text = selected and "ON" or "+"
            button.BackgroundColor3 = selected and (cinemaMode and Color3.fromRGB(46, 46, 49) or accent:Lerp(themeColor(Color3.fromRGB(12, 17, 29)), 0.65)) or surfaceColor(Color3.fromRGB(23, 33, 51))
        end
    end
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
end
openShopPicker = function(key)
    picker.Visible = true
    pickerTitle.Text = key == "animals" and "Animals to buy" or (key == "foods" and "Food to buy" or "Decorations to buy")
    pickerHint.Text = "Loading items..."
    spawnManaged(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            loadShops()
            if not alive then return end
            pickerKey = key
            for _, rowInfo in ipairs(pickerRows) do rowInfo.button:Destroy() end
            pickerRows = {}
            search.Text = ""
            local ids = {}
            for id, entry in pairs(shopConfig[shopCategory[key]]) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.Price) == "number" then table.insert(ids, id) end
            end
            table.sort(ids, function(a, b)
                local ap, bp = shopPrice(shopConfig[shopCategory[key]][a]), shopPrice(shopConfig[shopCategory[key]][b])
                return ap == bp and a < b or ap < bp
            end)
            for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
                local itemId = id
                local button = make("TextButton", list, {Text = "", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(422, 72), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 33, 51),
                    BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 234, 249),
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 12})
                round(button, 8)
                local text = label(button, "", UDim2.fromOffset(16, 10), UDim2.fromOffset(342, 24), 15)
                text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                text.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
                local detail = label(button, "", UDim2.fromOffset(16, 38), UDim2.fromOffset(342, 22), 12)
                detail.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
                local check = label(button, "+", UDim2.fromOffset(368, 20), UDim2.fromOffset(40, 28), 13)
                check.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
                button.Activated:Connect(function()
                    shopSelected[key][itemId] = not shopSelected[key][itemId] or nil
                    refreshPicker()
                end)
                table.insert(pickerRows, {id = itemId, button = button, text = text, detail = detail, check = check})
            end
            pickerHint.Text = #ids > 0 and "Select rows to buy automatically when stocked." or "Open this shop in the game once, then reopen this list."
            list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
            refreshPicker()
        end)
        if not ok and alive then pickerHint.Text = "Could not load items — see F9"; reportFailure("Shop", err) end
    end)
end
bind(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
    if shopConfig then
        local ok, err = pcall(refreshPicker)
        if not ok then reportFailure("Shop", err) end
    end
end)
local shopPending, shopRetry = nil, {}
local nextShopIndex = 1
local function tickShop()
    if not enabled.animals and not enabled.foods and not enabled.decorations then return end
    loadShops()
    if not alive then return end
    if shopPending then
        local p = shopPending
        if shopStock(p.key, p.id) < p.stock then
            if enabled[p.key] then status[p.key].Text = "Bought: " .. p.id end
            shopPending = nil
            return
        elseif os.clock() < p.deadline then
            if enabled[p.key] then status[p.key].Text = "Waiting for purchase confirmation" end
            return
        else
            shopRetry[p.key .. ":" .. p.id] = os.clock() + 20
            shopPending = nil
        end
    end
    local cash = cashBalance()
    if not cash then error("Waiting for cash balance") end
    local categories = {"animals", "foods", "decorations"}
    local order = {}
    for offset = 0, 2 do order[#order + 1] = categories[(nextShopIndex + offset - 1) % 3 + 1] end
    for _, key in ipairs(order) do
        if enabled[key] then
            local candidates, selectedCount = {}, 0
            for id in pairs(shopSelected[key]) do
                selectedCount = selectedCount + 1
                local entry = shopConfig[shopCategory[key]][id]
                if entry then
                    local stock, price = shopStock(key, id), shopPrice(entry)
                    if stock > 0 and price <= cash and shopUnlocked(key, id, entry) and os.clock() >= (shopRetry[key .. ":" .. id] or 0) then
                        table.insert(candidates, {id = id, stock = stock, price = price})
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.price == b.price and a.id < b.id or a.price < b.price end)
            local item = candidates[1]
            if item then
                local remote = path(RS, "Remotes", "Shop", "Buy")
                if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then error("Missing Shop.Buy remote") end
                if not alive or not enabled[key] or not shopSelected[key][item.id] then return end
                shopPending = {key = key, id = item.id, stock = item.stock, deadline = os.clock() + 8}
                remote:FireServer(shopCategory[key], {ItemName = item.id})
                status[key].Text = "Requested: " .. item.id .. " ($" .. item.price .. ")"
                nextShopIndex = key == "animals" and 2 or (key == "foods" and 3 or 1)
                return
            end
            status[key].Text = selectedCount == 0 and "Choose items below first" or "Waiting for stock, cash or unlock"
        end
    end
end
local pickerRefreshAt = 0
spawnManaged(function()
    while alive do
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            tickShop()
            if picker.Visible and os.clock() >= pickerRefreshAt then
                pickerRefreshAt = os.clock() + 2
                refreshPicker()
            end
        end)
        if not ok and alive then
            for _, key in ipairs({"animals", "foods", "decorations"}) do
                if enabled[key] then status[key].Text = "Shop check failed — see F9" end
            end
            reportFailure("Shop", err)
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

-- Shared animal/food stock countdown. An approximate fallback is marked with ~.
spawnManaged(function()
    local timerConfig
    while alive do
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            local reset = path(RS, "Values", "ShopResetTime")
            local resetAt = reset and reset:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(reset.Value)
            local remaining, approximate
            if resetAt and resetAt > 1000000000 then
                remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(resetAt - now))
                approximate = false
            else
                timerConfig = {GetTimeLeft=function(time) return 300 - math.floor(time) % 300 end}
                if not alive then return end
                if timerConfig and type(timerConfig.GetTimeLeft) == "function" then
                    remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(timerConfig.GetTimeLeft(now)))
                    approximate = true
                end
            end
            if not alive then return end
            if remaining then
                restockLabel.Text = remaining == 0 and "Restock: refreshing..." or
                    string.format("Restock: %s%02d:%02d", approximate and "~" or "", math.floor(remaining / 60), remaining % 60)
            else
                restockLabel.Text = "Restock: waiting..."
            end
        end)
        if not ok and alive then restockLabel.Text = "Restock: unavailable" end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local selling, cancelSelling = false, false
stopSellingUI = function() cancelSelling = true end
local function ownedAnimal(tool, serial)
    local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return tool.Parent ~= nil and (tool.Parent == backpack or tool.Parent == player.Character)
        and tool:GetAttribute("AnimalSerial") == serial and tool:GetAttribute("Favourite") ~= true
end
local function saleInventory()
    local result, seen = {}, {}
    local containers = {}
    local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if backpack then table.insert(containers, backpack) end
    if player.Character then table.insert(containers, player.Character) end
    for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
        for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                local serial = tool:GetAttribute("AnimalSerial")
                if serial and not seen[serial] and ownedAnimal(tool, serial) then
                    seen[serial] = true
                    table.insert(result, {tool = tool, serial = serial})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function selectedSaleInventory()
    local items = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(saleInventory()) do
        if sellSelected[item.serial] then table.insert(items, item) end
    end
    return items
end
bind(sellButton.Activated, function()
    if selling then cancelSelling = true; return end
    local items = selectedSaleInventory()
    if #items == 0 then sellStatus.Text = "Choose pets first"; return end
    local remote = path(RS, "Remotes", "Inventory", "SellAnimal")
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then sellStatus.Text = "SellAnimal remote not available"; return end
    selling, cancelSelling = true, false
    sellButton.Text = "Stop selling"
    spawnManaged(function()
        local requested = 0
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            -- Snapshot only: animals bought later are not included in this sale.
            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                if not alive or cancelSelling then break end
                if sellSelected[item.serial] and ownedAnimal(item.tool, item.serial) then
                    remote:FireServer(item.serial)
                    requested = requested + 1
                    sellStatus.Text = "Sale requested: " .. requested .. " / " .. #items
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end
        end)
        if not alive then return end
        if not ok then
            sellStatus.Text = "Sale failed — see F9 console"
            warn("[NoLimit Sell] " .. tostring(err))
        else
            sellStatus.Text = (cancelSelling and "Stopped. " or "Done. ") .. "Sale requests: " .. requested
        end
        task.wait(3)
        if alive then selling = false end
    end)
end)
spawnManaged(function()
    while alive do
        if not selling then
            local count = #selectedSaleInventory()
            sellButton.Text = "Sell Selected (" .. count .. ")"
            sellStatus.Text = "Selected pets: " .. count .. " / " .. #saleInventory()
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

local function renderSalePicker()
    for _, child in ipairs(saleList:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
    local items = saleInventory()
    local present = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do present[item.serial] = true end
    for serial in pairs(sellSelected) do if not present[serial] then sellSelected[serial] = nil end end
    table.sort(items, function(a, b)
        local an = tostring(a.tool:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or a.tool.Name)
        local bn = tostring(b.tool:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or b.tool.Name)
        return an == bn and tostring(a.serial) < tostring(b.serial) or an < bn
    end)
    local count = #selectedSaleInventory()
    saleHint.Text = #items == 0 and "No sellable inventory pets. Favourites are excluded." or (count .. " selected. Back returns without selling.")
    for i, item in ipairs(items) do
        local serial = item.serial
        local name = tostring(item.tool:GetAttribute("AnimalName") or item.tool.Name)
        local worth = tonumber(item.tool:GetAttribute("Worth")) or 0
        local b = make("TextButton", saleList, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i - 1) * 80), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(422, 72),
            Text = "",
            BackgroundColor3 = sellSelected[serial] and Color3.fromRGB(35, 69, 117) or Color3.fromRGB(23, 33, 51),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 234, 249),
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 22})
        round(b, 8)
        local text = label(b, (sellSelected[serial] and "[x]  " or "[ ]  ") .. name .. "  |  $" .. worth .. "\nID: " .. tostring(serial),
            UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8), UDim2.fromOffset(394, 56), 12)
        text.ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 1
        b.Activated:Connect(function()
            sellSelected[serial] = not sellSelected[serial] or nil
            renderSalePicker()
        end)
    end
    saleList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #items * 80)
end

row("battlepass", "Auto Claim Battlepass", "Claim unlocked pass rewards and completed Spooky quests.", 959)
local passConfig, passQuestsConfig
local passQuestRetry = {}
local function passActive()
    return alive and enabled.battlepass
end
local function tickPassQuests()
    if not passConfig then passConfig = configSnapshot.SpookyPassConfig end
    if not passQuestsConfig then passQuestsConfig = configSnapshot.QuestsConfig end
    if not passActive() then return end
    if (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SpookyTier")) or 0) >= passConfig.MaxTier then return end
    local state = rewardRemote("Quests", "GetState"):InvokeServer()
    if not passActive() then return end
    local section = type(state) == "table" and state.Spooky
    local pool = passQuestsConfig.Pools.Spooky
    if type(section) ~= "table" or type(section.List) ~= "table" or type(pool) ~= "table" then return end
    for i, quest in ipairs(section.List) do
        if not passActive() then return end
        if (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SpookyTier")) or 0) >= passConfig.MaxTier then return end
        local definition = pool[quest.Id]
        local key = tostring(section.ResetAt) .. ":" .. tostring(i) .. ":" .. tostring(quest.Id)
        if definition and not quest.Claimed and (tonumber(quest.Progress) or 0) >= definition.Target
            and os.clock() >= (passQuestRetry[key] or 0) then
            passQuestRetry[key] = os.clock() + 3
            local success = rewardRemote("Quests", "Claim"):InvokeServer("Spooky", i)
            task.wait(0.2)
            if not passActive() then return end
            status.battlepass.Text = success and "Collected completed Spooky quest" or "Quest not collected; checking again later"
        end
    end
end
local function tickPassRewards()
    if not passConfig then passConfig = configSnapshot.SpookyPassConfig end
    if not passActive() then return end
    local tier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SpookyTier")) or 0
    local premium = player:GetAttribute("SpookyPremium") == true
    local free = player:GetAttribute("SpookyFree")
    local paid = player:GetAttribute("SpookyPaid")
    local ready = 0
    for i = 1, math.min(tier, passConfig.MaxTier) do
        local entry = passConfig.Tiers[i]
        if entry then
            for _, track in ipairs({"Free", "Premium"}) do
                local flags = track == "Free" and free or paid
                local claimed = type(flags) == "string" and flags:sub(i, i) == "1"
                if (track == "Free" or premium) and not claimed and #passConfig.List(entry[track]) > 0 then
                    ready = ready + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if ready == 0 then
        status.battlepass.Text = "Waiting for unlocked rewards / completed quests"
        return
    end
    local success = rewardRemote("SpookyPass", "Claim"):InvokeServer("All")
    if passActive() then
        status.battlepass.Text = success == true and "Collected available battlepass rewards" or "Claim not confirmed; checking again later"
    end
end
spawnManaged(function()
    local nextCheck = 0
    while alive do
        if passActive() and os.clock() >= nextCheck then
            nextCheck = os.clock() + 3
            for _, callback in ipairs({tickPassQuests, tickPassRewards}) do
                if not passActive() then break end
                local ok, err = pcall(callback)
                if not ok and passActive() then
                    status.battlepass.Text = "Battlepass check failed — see F9"
                    reportFailure("Battlepass", err)
                end
            end
        elseif not enabled.battlepass then
            nextCheck = 0
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)



local function tickHalloweenDaily()
    local dailyGroup=path(RS,"Remotes","HalloweenDaily")
    if dailyGroup then
        local state=rewardRemote("HalloweenDaily","GetState"):InvokeServer()
        if not alive or not enabled.halloween then return end
        if type(state)=="table" and state.Ready==true then
            local key="HalloweenDaily:"..tostring(state.Next)..":"..tostring(state.ReadyAt)
            if os.clock()>=(rewardRetry[key] or 0) then
                rewardRetry[key]=os.clock()+3
                local success=rewardRemote("HalloweenDaily","Claim"):InvokeServer()
                if alive then status.halloween.Text=success and "Collected Halloween daily gift" or "Daily gift not ready" end
            end
        end
    end
end
local function tickHalloweenTasks()
    if not alive or not enabled.halloween or not path(RS,"Remotes","HalloweenQuest") then return end
    local state=rewardRemote("HalloweenQuest","GetState"):InvokeServer()
    if not alive or not enabled.halloween then return end
    if type(state)~="table" or not state.Active or type(state.Chapters)~="table" then return end
    for i,chapter in ipairs(state.Chapters) do
        local definition=configSnapshot.HalloweenChapters[i]
        if definition and chapter.Status=="Accepted" then
            local ready=false
            for _,quest in pairs(chapter.Quests or {}) do if quest.State=="Ready" then ready=true; break end end
            local key="HalloweenQuest:"..i
            if ready and os.clock()>=(rewardRetry[key] or 0) then
                rewardRetry[key]=os.clock()+5
                if not alive or not enabled.halloween then return end
                local success,message=rewardRemote("HalloweenQuest","TurnIn"):InvokeServer(definition.Npc)
                if alive then status.halloween.Text=success and "Collected tasks: "..definition.NpcName or "Turn-in pending: visit "..definition.NpcName end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end
    end
end
local function tickHalloween()
    for _,callback in ipairs({tickHalloweenDaily,tickHalloweenTasks}) do
        if not alive or not enabled.halloween then return end
        local ok,err=pcall(callback)
        if not ok then
            status.halloween.Text="Event check failed — see F9"
            reportFailure("Halloween",err)
        end
    end
end
local function startClaimWorker(key,callback)
    spawnManaged(function()
        while alive do
            if enabled[key] then guarded(key,callback) end
            task.wait(3)
        end
    end)
end
startClaimWorker("quests",tickQuestRewards)
startClaimWorker("halloween",tickHalloween)

-- Settings extensions: named local profiles and a separate performance window.
local extras = {fps = false, autoLoad = true, database = {schema = 1, profiles = {}}, loaded = false}
extras.http = game:GetService("HttpService")
extras.file = "NoLimitRaiseAnimals/profiles-" .. tostring(player.UserId) .. ".json"
extras.fileReady = type(readfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function"
function extras.position(value)
    return {value.X.Scale, value.X.Offset, value.Y.Scale, value.Y.Offset}
end
function extras.decodePosition(value, fallback)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return fallback end
    for i = 1, 4 do if type(value[i]) ~= "number" or value[i] ~= value[i] or math.abs(value[i]) > 100000 then return fallback end end
    return UDim2.new(value[1], value[2], value[3], value[4])
end
function extras.keepOnScreen(frame)
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end
    local view = camera.ViewportSize
    local size = frame.AbsoluteSize
    local anchor = frame.AnchorPoint
    local pos = frame.Position
    local x = pos.X.Scale * view.X + pos.X.Offset
    local y = pos.Y.Scale * view.Y + pos.Y.Offset
    local minX, maxX = size.X * anchor.X, view.X - size.X * (1 - anchor.X)
    local minY, maxY = size.Y * anchor.Y, view.Y - size.Y * (1 - anchor.Y)
    frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x, minX, math.max(minX, maxX)), math.clamp(y, minY, math.max(minY, maxY)))
end

    extras.performance.Visible = extras.fps

extras.frames, extras.elapsed = 0, 0
bind(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function(dt)
    extras.frames = extras.frames + 1; extras.elapsed = extras.elapsed + dt
    if extras.elapsed < 0.5 then return end
    if extras.fps then
        local fps = math.floor(extras.frames / extras.elapsed + 0.5)
        local ping
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
        if ok then ping = tonumber(value) end
        if not ping then
            local success, seconds = pcall(player.GetNetworkPing, player)
            if success then ping = seconds * 1000 end
        end
        extras.perfValue.Text = "FPS " .. fps .. "    Ping " .. (ping and (math.floor(ping + 0.5) .. " ms") or "--")
    end
    extras.frames, extras.elapsed = 0, 0
end)

function extras.refreshProfiles()
    for _, child in ipairs(extras.profileList:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(extras.database.profiles) do table.insert(names, name) end
    table.sort(names)
    for i, name in ipairs(names) do
        local b = make("TextButton", extras.profileList, {Text = name .. (extras.database.autoLoad == name and "  ·  auto-load" or ""),
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i - 1) * 30), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(396, 26),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 53), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 236, 255),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12})
        round(b, 6)
        b.Activated:Connect(function() extras.nameInput.Text = name end)
    end
    extras.profileList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #names * 30)
    extras.autoButton.Text = "Auto-load saved profile: " .. (extras.autoLoad and "ON" or "OFF")
end
function extras.writeDatabase()
    if not extras.fileReady then error("Executor file access is unavailable") end
    if not extras.loaded then error("Profiles could not be read; existing file was not overwritten") end
    local folderOK = type(isfolder) == "function" and isfolder("NoLimitRaiseAnimals")
    if not folderOK then pcall(makefolder, "NoLimitRaiseAnimals") end
    local encoded = extras.http:JSONEncode(extras.database)
    if isfile(extras.file) then writefile(extras.file .. ".backup", readfile(extras.file)) end
    writefile(extras.file, encoded)
end
function extras.name()
    local name = extras.nameInput.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if name == "" or #name > 60 then error("Enter a profile name (1–60 characters)") end
    return name
end
function extras.snapshot()
    local state = {schema = 1, theme = themeName, key = menuKey.Name, enabled = {}, selections = {}, saleSelection = {},
        fps = extras.fps, gifEnabled = extras.gifEnabled ~= false, page = activePage, window = extras.position(panel.Position), logo = extras.position(reopen.Position),
        performance = extras.position(extras.performance.Position)}
    for key, value in pairs(enabled) do state.enabled[key] = value end
    for key, selected in pairs(shopSelected) do
        state.selections[key] = {}
        for id in pairs(selected) do table.insert(state.selections[key], id) end
    end
    for serial in pairs(sellSelected) do table.insert(state.saleSelection, serial) end
    return state
end
function extras.applyProfile(state)
    if type(state) ~= "table" or state.schema ~= 1 then error("Unsupported profile format") end
    -- Load selections first; automation is restored only after setup is complete.
    loadShops()
    if not alive then return end
    for key in pairs(enabled) do enabled[key] = false end
    if stopSellingUI then stopSellingUI() end
    for key, selected in pairs(shopSelected) do
        table.clear(selected)
        local saved = type(state.selections) == "table" and state.selections[key]
        if type(saved) == "table" then
            for _, id in ipairs(saved) do
                if type(id) == "string" then selected[id] = true end
            end
        end
    end
    table.clear(sellSelected)
    if type(state.saleSelection) == "table" then
        for _, serial in ipairs(state.saleSelection) do if type(serial) == "string" then sellSelected[serial] = true end end
    end
    if themes[state.theme] then applyTheme(state.theme) end
    if type(state.key) == "string" then
        local ok, key = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[state.key] end)
        if ok and key and key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape then menuKey = key end
    end
    captureKey = false
    keyButton.Text = "Menu key: " .. menuKey.Name
    footer.Text = menuKey.Name .. "  menu  ·  X / CTRL+END  quit"
    panel.Position = extras.decodePosition(state.window, panel.Position)
    reopen.Position = extras.decodePosition(state.logo, reopen.Position)
    extras.performance.Position = extras.decodePosition(state.performance, extras.performance.Position)
    fit()
    extras.keepOnScreen(panel); extras.keepOnScreen(reopen); extras.keepOnScreen(extras.performance)
    extras.setFPS(state.fps)
    extras.gifEnabled = state.gifEnabled ~= false
    if extras.setGIF then extras.setGIF(extras.gifEnabled) end
    if pages[state.page] then selectPage(state.page) end
    refreshPicker()
    if type(state.enabled) == "table" and state.enabled.quests == nil then state.enabled.quests = state.enabled.rewards == true end
    for key in pairs(enabled) do
        enabled[key] = type(state.enabled) == "table" and state.enabled[key] == true
        toggleViews[key].Text = enabled[key] and "ON" or "OFF"
        toggleViews[key].BackgroundColor3 = enabled[key] and (cinemaMode and Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 67) or accent) or surfaceColor(Color3.fromRGB(44, 54, 74))
        status[key].Text = enabled[key] and "Checking..." or "Off"
    end
end
function extras.runProfileAction(callback)
    spawnManaged(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(callback)
        if not ok and alive then extras.profileStatus.Text = tostring(err):gsub("^.-:%d+: ", "") end
    end)
end
bind(extras.saveButton.Activated, function()
    extras.runProfileAction(function()
        local name = extras.name()
        local state = extras.snapshot()
        extras.database.profiles[name] = state
        if extras.autoLoad then extras.database.autoLoad = name end
        extras.writeDatabase()
        extras.refreshProfiles()
        extras.profileStatus.Text = "Saved: " .. name
    end)
end)
bind(extras.loadButton.Activated, function()
    extras.runProfileAction(function()
        local name = extras.name()
        local state = extras.database.profiles[name]
        if not state then error("Profile not found") end
        extras.applyProfile(state)
        if extras.autoLoad then extras.database.autoLoad = name; extras.writeDatabase(); extras.refreshProfiles() end
        extras.profileStatus.Text = "Loaded: " .. name
    end)
end)
bind(extras.deleteButton.Activated, function()
    extras.runProfileAction(function()
        local name = extras.name()
        if not extras.database.profiles[name] then error("Profile not found") end
        extras.database.profiles[name] = nil
        if extras.database.autoLoad == name then extras.database.autoLoad = nil end
        extras.writeDatabase(); extras.refreshProfiles()
        extras.profileStatus.Text = "Deleted profile: " .. name
    end)
end)
bind(extras.autoButton.Activated, function()
    extras.runProfileAction(function()
        local nextValue = not extras.autoLoad
        if nextValue then
            local name = extras.name()
            if not extras.database.profiles[name] then error("Save this profile first") end
            extras.database.autoLoad = name
        else extras.database.autoLoad = nil end
        extras.writeDatabase()
        extras.autoLoad = nextValue
        extras.refreshProfiles()
    end)
end)
extras.refreshProfiles()
if not extras.fileReady then
    extras.profileStatus.Text = "Profiles require readfile / writefile support in your executor."
else
    extras.runProfileAction(function()
        if isfile(extras.file) then
            local data = extras.http:JSONDecode(readfile(extras.file))
            if type(data) ~= "table" or data.schema ~= 1 or type(data.profiles) ~= "table" then error("Invalid profile file; backup preserved") end
            extras.database = data
            extras.autoLoad = type(data.autoLoad) == "string"
        end
        extras.loaded = true
        extras.refreshProfiles()
        local name = extras.database.autoLoad
        if type(name) == "string" and extras.database.profiles[name] then
            extras.nameInput.Text = name
            extras.applyProfile(extras.database.profiles[name])
            extras.profileStatus.Text = "Automatically loaded: " .. name
        else extras.profileStatus.Text = "Enter a name and Save to keep this setup." end
    end)
end

-- Embedded transparent crown: no separate download is needed in the executor.
function extras.decode64(text)
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local values = {}
    for i = 1, #alphabet do values[alphabet:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end
    local bytes = {}
    for i = 1, #text, 4 do
        local a, b, c, d = text:sub(i, i), text:sub(i + 1, i + 1), text:sub(i + 2, i + 2), text:sub(i + 3, i + 3)
        local n = (values[a] or 0) * 262144 + (values[b] or 0) * 4096 + (values[c] or 0) * 64 + (values[d] or 0)
        bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256)
        if c ~= "=" and c ~= "" then bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 256) % 256) end
        if d ~= "=" and d ~= "" then bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(n % 256) end
    end
    return table.concat(bytes)
end
function extras.installCrown()
    local asset = type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset or (type(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset)
    if not asset or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then return end
    pcall(makefolder, "NoLimitRaiseAnimals")
    local file = "NoLimitRaiseAnimals/crown-transparent-v2.png"
    writefile(file, extras.decode64(extras.crownData))
    local uri = asset(file)
    if not alive then return end
    extras.crownIcons = {}
    for _, spec in ipairs({{parent = sidebar, position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 18), size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 42)},
        {parent = reopen, position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5), size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38)},
        {parent = extras.performance, position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), size = UDim2.fromOffset(23, 23)}}) do
        local icon = make("ImageLabel", spec.parent, {Image = uri, Position = spec.position, Size = spec.size,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ImageColor3 = accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.65), ZIndex = spec.parent == extras.performance and 41 or 3})
        table.insert(extras.crownIcons, icon)
    end
    logo.Visible, reopen.Text = false, ""
    extras.perfTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(39, 9)
    extras.perfTitle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(142, 24)
    extras.perfTitle.Text = "NoLimit / Performance"
end
refreshExtrasTheme = function()
    for _, icon in ipairs(extras.crownIcons or {}) do icon.ImageColor3 = accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.65) end
    extras.fpsButton.BackgroundColor3 = extras.fps and (cinemaMode and Color3.fromRGB(46, 46, 49) or accent:Lerp(themeColor(Color3.fromRGB(12, 17, 29)), 0.45)) or surfaceColor(Color3.fromRGB(28, 43, 68))
end
bind(extras.fpsButton.Activated, refreshExtrasTheme)
bind(extras.perfClose.Activated, refreshExtrasTheme)
extras.crownData = [[]]
spawnManaged(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(extras.installCrown)
    if not ok then warn("[NoLimit Crown] " .. tostring(err)) end
    extras.crownData = nil
    if alive then refreshExtrasTheme() end
end)

    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 43, 68), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 236, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 13})

function extras.setGIF(on)
    extras.gifEnabled = on == true
    cinemaMode = extras.gifEnabled
    extras.gifImage.Visible = extras.gifEnabled and extras.gifReady
    extras.gifButton.Text = extras.gifEnabled and "Original GIF: ON" or "Original GIF: OFF"
    for obj in pairs(themedObjects) do
        if obj.Parent and not obj:GetAttribute("KeepPalette") and (obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")) then
            local base = obj:GetAttribute("BaseSurfaceTransparency")
            if type(base) == "number" and base < 1 then
                local root = obj.Parent:IsA("ScreenGui")
                obj.BackgroundTransparency = extras.gifEnabled and (root and 0 or (obj.ZIndex >= 9 and 0.04 or (obj:IsA("Frame") and 0.70 or 0.30))) or base
            end
        end
    end
    applyTheme(themeName)
    if cinemaMode then panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(3, 3, 4) end
    refreshPicker()
end
bind(extras.gifButton.Activated, function() extras.setGIF(not extras.gifEnabled) end)
function extras.installGIF()
    local getAsset = type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset or (type(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset)
    if not getAsset or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
        extras.gifButton.Text = "GIF needs local asset support"
        return
    end
    pcall(makefolder, "NoLimitRaiseAnimals")
    local layers = {}
    for i, encoded in ipairs(extras.gifData) do
        if not alive then return end
        local file = "NoLimitRaiseAnimals/star-gif-smooth-v2-" .. i .. ".png"
        writefile(file, extras.decode64(encoded))
        layers[i] = make("ImageLabel", extras.gifImage, {Name = "ResidentSheet" .. i, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Image = getAsset(file), ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(500, 300),
            ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero, ZIndex = 0})
        round(layers[i], 18)
        task.wait()
    end
    if not alive then return end
    -- Show the first real render surface before preloading: some local-asset
    -- loaders never report IsLoaded for a hidden, fully transparent ancestor.
    -- A delayed sheet must not make the entire background fail.
    layers[1].ImageTransparency = 0
    extras.gifReady = true
    extras.setGIF(extras.gifEnabled)
    local loadedAssets, preloadFinished, failures = {}, false, 0
    spawnManaged(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(layers, function(assetId, fetchStatus)
                local success = fetchStatus == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success
                loadedAssets[tostring(assetId)] = success
                if not success then failures = failures + 1 end
            end)
        end)
        if not ok then
            failures = failures + 1
            warn("[NoLimit Background preload] " .. tostring(err))
        end
        preloadFinished = true
    end)
    local elapsed, lastFrame, previousLayer = 0, -1, layers[1]
    bind(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function(dt)
        if not alive or not panel.Visible or not extras.gifEnabled then return end
        elapsed = (elapsed + dt) % 4.4
        local frame = math.floor(elapsed / 0.05) % 88
        if frame == lastFrame then return end
        local sheet, cell = math.floor(frame / 6) + 1, frame % 6
        local layer = layers[sheet]
        local ready = layer.IsLoaded or loadedAssets[tostring(layer.Image)] == true or (preloadFinished and failures == 0)
        -- Keep the last visible frame while another sheet loads, instead of
        -- switching to a blank texture. Rendering will retry on the next frame.
        if layer ~= previousLayer and not ready then return end
        -- Rect and visibility changes land together on the next render; no texture upload here.
        layer.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((cell % 2) * 500, math.floor(cell / 2) * 300)
        if previousLayer ~= layer then
            layer.ImageTransparency = 0
            if previousLayer then previousLayer.ImageTransparency = 1 end
            previousLayer = layer
        end
        lastFrame = frame
    end)
end

end)
